d:
In the mountains, Kikyou encounters an old man who appears to be the monk Hakushin, and gently touches him in an attempt to help him attain enlightenment.
However, the old man sucks the life and soul out of Kikyou, and after satisfying himself in various ways, he demonstrates his monstrous nature by attaining enlightenment all on his own.

—

山で白心上人らしきおじいさんに遭遇し、成仏させるために優しくおじいさんに触れる桔梗
しかし、おじいさんは桔梗の乳と霊魂を吸いつくし、なんやかんやしてして満足した後、勝手に成仏する鬼畜ぶりを見せつける
